== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Dreadnought City is a location situated on the [[Everwood continent]]. It is characterized by its massive [[scale]], featuring black, spiked walls that extend to the horizon and a landscape of ruined streets. The city is protected by three [[Chief Guardians]], who are ancient Archlord{{!}}Archlords possessing highly advanced [[Remnants]] that appear physically solid. The city's [[inhabitants]] have been known to engage in unusual practices involving [[Remnants]], and its citizens have sought refuge elsewhere following various conflicts.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Dreadnought City, a location characterized by its ruined streets, faces a dire siege from the drones of the [[Silent King]]. The city is protected by three [[Chief Guardians]], though [[Lindon]] was forced to confront three Archlord{{!}}Archlords in the skies directly above the settlement. As the conflict intensifies, an evacuation of the city is initiated. Despite these hardships, Dreadnought City continues to function by sending out foreign emissaries.}}
